adjudication.rationale: In `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts`, the new `loadUsers` wrapper catches errors and rethrows `Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError` as `new HttpError({ statusCode: 400, ... })`. This is an overbroad mapping: Prisma “known request” errors can represent server-side/database failures (including transient infrastructure issues), which should surface as 5xx rather than 400. The change is introduced by this diff (previously there was no such catch/remap), and it would misclassify backend failures as client errors, discouraging retries and potentially suppressing 5xx alerting.
